Amendment 2 makes EU-only hosting mandatory. The current region matrix supports US hosting only, so I will draft No for Q3 and keep that gap visible in the executive summary. The old answer library cannot establish current capability or SLA approval.
Give me the actual eight answers and the owner questions. Keep the internal source notes and reference contact out of buyer copy.

I prepared outputs/rfp-response-draft.md and outputs/rfp-response-producer-handoff.md with the private structured record. Q1 covers forms, sequential approvals and status visibility. Q2 supports SAML 2.0 in Enterprise 4.2. Q3 states No: application data, backups and logs are US-only. Q4 covers administrator CSV export and excludes uploaded attachments. Q5 leaves SLA and credits pending. Q6 discloses no reference. Q7 lists delivery activities without a date commitment. Q8 marks both requested attachments not supplied. All 21 subquestions are covered; the mandatory hosting gap prevents any submission-readiness claim.
